result.brief: 提出注意力引导的世界动作模型，通过三个即插即用注意力模块改进未来观测与动作联合预测，提升机器人操作精度与效率。
result.reason: Proposes attention-guidance modules inside World Action Models that jointly predict future observations and actions, improving manipulation control; main contribution is robot policy-oriented world action modeling.
